Mit einem vollen 3-Liter-Tank kann unsere gasbetriebene Wasserpumpe bis zu 146 Minuten laufen und hat einen geringen Kraftstoffverbrauch von nur 1,23 l/h. Für eine optimale Leistung empfehlen wir die Verwendung von bleifreiem Benzin.

Sie sind von Einschränkungen bei der Stromversorgung befreit und können jederzeit und überall mit der Wasserversorgung beginnen! Die Wasserpumpe mit Gasmotor eignet sich perfekt für Bewässerung, Entwässerung, Poolwasseraustausch usw.
Unsere Müllpumpe arbeitet dank ihrer dicken Schutzstange aus Kohlenstoffstahl und mehreren stoßdämpfenden Fußpolstern reibungslos und leise und verhindert so ein Verrutschen und Kippen und reduziert gleichzeitig effektiv den Lärm.

title: Cat Muzzle With Cute Cat Ears, Breathable Mesh Cat Hood For Grooming, Anti-Bite Anti-Scratch Cat Face Cover, Adjustable Drawstring Cat Neck Cover For Nail Trimming, Bathing & Vet Visits
body_html:
Five Features

NO MORE BITES OR SCRATCHES Trim nails, clean ears, give pills — without getting clawed. The mesh hood keeps teeth and claws away from your hands. Grooming stops being a wrestling match.

YOUR CAT CAN STILL SEE The wide front opening leaves both eyes clear. Your cat doesn't feel blindfolded, so it panics far less. Calmer cat, faster job.

BREATHABLE MESH, NOT A SAUNA The mesh body lets air move through, so it stays cool even in summer. Light enough that most cats forget they have it on.

ONE PULL, STAYS PUT A single drawstring with a toggle lock adjusts to any neck size. It won't slip off or get pawed away halfway through.

CUTE CAT-EARS, EASY TO WASH The little ears make it look like a hat, not a muzzle. Hand wash in cool water and air dry — ready for the next bath day.

Description

Bath time shouldn't end with scratched arms.

This is a soft mesh hood that covers your cat's mouth and neck — the two spots that do the damage. The front stays open so your cat can see everything. That's what keeps it calm.

The fabric is light and airy. No sweating, no heavy plastic cone. The drawstring tightens with one hand and locks in place, so it won't slide off while you work.

Cute cat ears on top. Because a scared cat in a scary-looking mask makes everything worse.

How to use Slide it over the head, pull the drawstring snug, and leave two fingers of room under the neck. Take it off as soon as you're done. Never leave it on an unattended cat.

Wash & care Hand wash in cool water with mild soap. Air dry flat. Do not bleach, do not tumble dry.

Where it fits into your week Nail trims at home. Ear cleaning and meds. Bath time and blow drying. Vet visits and travel carriers.

Sizes S — small cats, up to about 8 lb / 3.5 kg M — average to large cats, 8–15 lb / 3.5–7 kg

Measure around the neck and add one finger of slack. When in doubt, size up.

Use it at home, at the vet, on the road.
